notes.title: Crafting Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! We are back with a new huge update! We are continuously learning from your reviews (thanks) and we have fixed issues and made a CRAFTING mechanic.
How do you access to the crafting menu?
If you click the forging icon in the game (image of a cat forging a banana) some icons will pop up with a cat+cat2=cat3 type of thing, for now you can craft only one cat (sleepyworkercatnana) and we think that we will change the craftings every 2 weeks (this might change though).

Video of the update:
[previewyoutube=2I5Se575wj8;full][/previewyoutube]

Fixes: 
azerty keyboard’s konami code now working

Remember to join our Discord server if you need help, send us your catnanas or just want to chat! 
https://discord.gg/BxXUknk6qe

notes.title: Flappy Update! (new mode)
notes.content:
We have added a new mode for all the people that think banana cat is not a real game!
The mode is called "Flappy Nana" and we'll leave a YouTube video link so that you can see what it is about.
Video of the update: [previewyoutube=uRW_oKI8wmk;full][/previewyoutube]

Fixes:
-165/144/120hz monitor high GPU usage 
-Now the game saves the amount of clicks when you close it

notes.title: Banana Cat Has Been Released!
notes.content:
Guys Banana Cat has been released! In the first week of its release the "GnomeCatnana" (Common rarity) will be available for only 7 days (until the 15th of july - 8 am)! Try to obtain it as soon as possible so that when it would be unobtainable it will value a lot! What are you waiting for?
https://i.imgur.com/Gtd9bf7.png
Rarities (they drop every hour) : 

 Common - 58,89%
 Rare - 15%
 Epic - 5%
 Mystical -  1% 
 Legendary - 0,1%
